name: Radar
description: This paint was originally created with the intent of having a radar that drivers can see no matter where they look. Unfortunately, it didn't quite work as planned. But on the flip-side, the paint now has a hypnotic effect on whoever looks at it. ""You are a toaster. Listen to me... YOU are a toaster""
interestingFacts: Radar was added to the game on August 9th, 2019 as part of the 2019 Summer Sales event.
This paint was part of a special bundle for 59.90 USD and is now only obtainable from Containers.
